argument: Every original source-valid placement has strictly positive pair gap greater than211um. Replace each continuous normalized orthogonal anchor or transformed cog center by its nearest integer micrometre. Each translation changes by at most sqrt(0.5^2+0.5^2)<0.708um, so every pair retains positive gap after a relative change<1.416um. All collision cores were contained in the source outers before that common translation. Closed no-fit polygons therefore remain avoided; integer facet expressions strictly outside them satisfy at least support+1. The stock bounds are rounded outward by2um and contain the at-most0.5um coordinate change. This proves a source-valid13 placement maps into the proposed necessary integer model, with no sampled cog-angle restriction. It does not prove the reverse mapping or original feasibility.
